Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.testing.mock.builders

Class MockSceneBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.tools.testing.mock.builders.MockSceneBuilder
public class MockSceneBuilder extends Object
Builder for creating mock Scene and SceneAnalysis objects for testing. Provides properly initialized objects that avoid NPEs in tests.
